content:
The AirPods deals are still flying with AirPods Pro 3 down at one of the best prices ever and AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, but today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by a special 1-day-only Apple sale as part of Best Buy’s 60th Anniversary sale event. It is delivering a straight up $400 off a pair of M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs in brand new condition, the best price ever on iPhone Air at $170 off (or you can land open-box units at up to $406 off), and even up to $200 off Beats Studio Pro headphones. Those deals also join the ongoing all-time low on AirTag 2 as well as this 512GB iPad mini at $450 under the new list price. Scope it all out below.

AirPods deals just dropped even lower, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more

After summer full of solid deals on Apple’s latest AirPods lineup, just about all of them have just dropped even lower. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now sitting at one of the best prices ever at 25% off, but we also saw AirPods 4 with ANC dip to the lowest price in several months and AirPods Max 2 have dropped even lower as of this morning to $120 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

Best Buy launches 1-day anniversary Apple sale: MacBook Pro $400 off, iPhone Air all-time low, accessories from $29, more

As part of its massive 60th Anniversary Sale, Best Buy is running a series of 1-day flash sales focused on specific brands, and today it’s all about Apple. While Amazon still has some particularly standout Apple deals this week, including AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off (one of the best deals yet), the new AirTag 2 down at all-time low pricing, and AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, Apple has now taken over the Best Buy Deals of the Day page for 24-hours only. Highlights include $400 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro, a new all-time low on iPhone Air, and official accessories from $29. Details below.

Best Buy 60th Anniversary – 1-day Apple sale

Apple now owns the Best Buy Deals of the Day page through midnight tonight. This is very much not something we see very often (outside of daily events during Black Friday) and it is definitely worth taking a look while you can.

Again, Amazon is either matching or undercutting Best Buy on select Apple gear this week, but the Deals of the Day offerings do feature some discounts you won’t also find at Amazon:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (Reg. $3,199) – $400 off
  • Apple iPhone Air 512GB – Sky Blue $1,030 (Reg. $1,200) – $170 off
    • Also available at $160 off in other colors/storage options
  • 11-inch M3 iPad Air 512GB Cell $849 (Orig. $1,049)
    • The 512GB cell model M4 costs $1,199
  • Save up to 25% or more on select Apple iPhone accessories from $29
    • Cases, wallets, and more
  • Beats Studio Pro Wireless ANC Headphones $140 (Reg. $350)

Apple’s 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs are $400 off for today only

As part of this week’s Best Buy 60th Anniversary sale, today is Apple Day. Both Best Buy and Amazon have launched new Apple deals for today only and right now we are focused on the sizable $400 price drops landing on a pair of 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs.

You’ll now find both of the 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro models Amazon and Best Buy carry down at $400 off the list price:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (Reg. $2,999)
  • 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (Reg. $3,199)
  • 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

Both now at $400 off the list price for today only, the difference between the two configs above is just the CPU/GPU Cores.

Brand new condition iPhone Air hits all-time low at $170 off, Best Buy open-box units up to $406 off (Today only)

For today only, as part of its 60th Anniversary Apple flash sale, Best Buy is delivering a new all-time low on brand new condition, unlocked iPhone Air at $170 off the list price. You can also land this same model at a giant $406 off the new sticker price in “excellent” open-box condition (additional colors and storage options also on sale below).

Best Buy is now offering Apple’s iPhone Air 512GB model starting at $1,029.99 shipped in Sky Blue. Only the Sky Blue variant is seeing the special 1-day sale pricing today, but the other colors are still on sale at $1,039.99 shipped anyway:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $840 (Reg. $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,040 (Reg. $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,240 (Reg. $1,400)

The $160 off across the the rest of the lineup is matching the Black Friday all-time low, but the one config featured above at $170 off is now sitting at the lowest price we have tracked in new, unlocked condition.

That said, you can land just about all of these iPhone Air models for much less than that in Best Buy’s “excellent” open-box condition right now:

  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $793 (Reg. $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB Space Black $798 (Reg. $999)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $847 (Reg. $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Space Black $987 (Reg. $1,199)

***Note: Look on this listing page, choose your storage capacity and color, and the scroll down on the right to the “More options from Best Buy” section and look for the “open-box excellent” listing. \

Official Apple accessories up to 30% off for today only: iPhone 17/Pro cases, Crossbody Straps, more

Today is Apple day folks. Alongside AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, and AirTag 2 down at all-time low pricing, Apple has taken over the Deals of the Day at Best Buy and we are now tracking loads of new price drops on Amazon as well. We have already detailed the $400 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro, and now it’s time for the official Apple accessories at up to nearly 30% off.

Both Amazon and Best Buy are now offering a series of discounts on Apple’s latest iPhone 17 series case lineup, Crossbody Straps, MagSafe wallets, and some previous-generation iPhone cases over at Best Buy.

You’ll find a couple pages worth of Apple accessory discounts live over at Best Buy and we have pulled some highlights from Amazon down below – be sure to double check both options for the lowest price on the exact color and model you’re after.

Most affordable M5 MacBook Air back at $1,099 via Apple refurb if you’re quick ($200 off new list)

This offer probably won’t last for long folks – it never does, but the official Apple refurb store has now re-stocked the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro down at $1,099 shipped in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This particular configuration sells out very quickly when comes back in stock at Apple, so you won’t want to sleep on this if you’re interested – it is the most affordable price for an M5 MacBook Air after all.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage down at $1,099 shipped. As mentioned above, it is, at the time of writing, available on the Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue colorways.

The is a regularly $1,299 machine sitting at $200 off the new list price.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299 new)

As a quick reminder, all units for the official Apple renewed shop include the following:

  • Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Apple’s Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale

For comparison’s sake, Amazon is charging very close to the $1,299 MSRP on this model in new condition, with the Silver variant down at $1,240.

Amazon has this 512GB iPad mini at $450 under the new list price (Renewed Premium)

While we just started to see some deals landing on iPad Air this week, discounts on iPad in general have been somewhere between weak and non-existent as of late. That said, we did just spot Amazon offering a 512GB iPad mini at a giant $450 off the new list price in its top quality Renewed Premium condition.

Amazon is now offering the 512GB iPad mini A17 – the latest model – down at $449 shipped right now.

This is now an $899 iPad from Apple in new condition you can land right now straight from Amazon at $450 less than that.

It is also worth mentioning that, even before the price hike took hold, we had never seen this model drop below $679 in new condition at Amazon.

As a quick reminder, an Amazon Renewed Premium unit is not the same as a standard renewed listing, or even an “excellent” condition refurb. It, instead, ships with the following:

  • Screen: When present, no scratches.
  • Body: No signs of cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, and other) are visible when the product is held 12 inches away.
  • Battery: When included, batteries have a capacity that exceeds 90% of the original battery life.
  • Accessories: Generic or original equipment manufacturer accessories and packaging provided.
  • Guarantee: Renewed Premium items come with a 365-day return period.

AirTag 2 now back at some of the lowest prices ever from $22 each (4-pack and single)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 “excellent” open-box $20 (Reg. $29 new) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (Reg. $99)

Beats Studio Pro ANC headphones now $200 off list price in 1-day Apple anniversary sale

Best Buy, as part of its 60th Anniversary Sale, has now launched a 1-day Apple sale. The ongoing AirPods Max 2 deal at $120 off and AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off are now joined by a sizable $200 price drop on Beats Studio Pro ANC Wireless headphones – you can also score open-box units as $114.

As part of its 1-day Apple sale, Best Buy is now offering the Beats Studio Pro Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones down as low as $149.99 shipped.

Carrying a $350 list price, this is $200 off the MSRP, the lowest price we can find from a reputable source in brand new condition, and a deal that is only live through today. Amazon is charging $170 for these cans right now.

You will find “excellent” open-box condition units of these same headphones down at $113.99 shipped, and that is a lower price for sure, but it is only $36 less than the brand new set in today’s Deals of the Day.

While the Studio Pro carry a $350 list price, they have more regularly sold for between $170 and $250 at Amazon in 2026. Today’s deal is, nonetheless, lower than that and among the best we have tracked from a major retailer.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • This tiny 1TB portable SSD is now 50% off at a $150 all-time low – a rare deal amid rising storage costs
  • This Anker 8-outlet Power Strip with USB and surge protection is $22 today
  • Govee’s latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite with Matter down at $85, or save up to 47% on other models from $80
  • Twelve South’s all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C Charger now down at $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker’s Nano 100W 3-Port Charger comes with a 5-foot cable down at $36 today
  • Twelve South TimePorter Apple Watch Band Organizer hits best price of year at $21 Prime shipped

Latest Apple Magic Mouse up to 35% off with deals from $56 (Black and White models)

We caught some particularly notable deals on Apple’s latest USB-C Magic Mouse release this year a Amazon and even an all-time low during Prime Day, but the Best Buy 60th Anniversary Sale is delivering some solid discounts right now and even lower prices on excellent open-box condition offers from $57 (on both the white and black model).

Best Buy is now offering the classic white/silver Magic Mouse down at $67.99 (currently $69 at Amazon) and the regularly $99 black model at $84.99 shipped in brand new condition.

***Note: You’ll save an extra $12 on the white and $15 on the black if you bundle them with a MacBook purchase right now.

This is at least 15% off the list prices and the best we can find in new condition from a reputable source. Again we did see both models for less than this during the Prime Day sale back in June, but those all-time lows are long gone and considering how rare deals can be on Magic Mouse (historically speaking), we thought these deals should be on the radar for folks looking for a refresh right now.

But you’ll also find even lower prices in “excellent” open-box condition at Best Buy right now:

  • White Apple Magic Mouse $56 (Reg. $79 new)
  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $67 (Reg. $99 new)

More of the best 60th Anniversary Apple deals:

Anker’s 2026 Back to School sale drops chargers, power banks, and Qi2.2 gear back to Prime Day lows from just $10 (46% off)

Update 08/17: The deals are still live at Amazon via the brand’s official storefront. More details in the original post below.

Anker is now running a Back to School sale across its lineup of accessories, with promo code SCHOOL20 taking 20% off sitewide on chargers, power banks, cables, charging stations, and more. The brand’s official Amazon storefront is matching many of those offers as well, while also serving up a few additional discounts of its own across popular models. There are deals on everything from compact Nano chargers and multi-port laptop bricks to MagSafe charging gear, power banks, and other everyday accessories. Many of the Amazon offers are bringing prices back down to the same all-time lows we tracked during the recent Prime Day sale, giving you another shot at those best-ever prices without having to wait for the next major shopping event. If you’re putting together a new school or work setup, or simply need to refresh your charging gear, there are plenty of solid Anker deals worth checking out right now.

Anker’s 2026 Back to School sale is now live

The brand’s official Amazon storefront has added a handful of new deals to the mix, and we’ve highlighted those below along with some of the existing offers for you to check out.

  • Anker 45W Nano charger with Smart display $26 (Reg. $40)
  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 Charging Station with display $135 (Reg. $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch control $116 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker 140W 4-port laptop charger with display $65 (Reg. $90)
  • Anker 25,000mAh 165W laptop power bank with dual USB-C cables $105 (Reg. $120)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 docking station with detachable 6-in-1 hub $112 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 charging station $72 (Reg. $90)
  • Anker Nano ultra-slim 5,000mAh MagSafe power bank $44 (Reg. $55)
  • Code SCHOOL20
  • And even more…

One of the standout offers in the sale brings Anker’s latest 45W Nano USB-C charger with a Smart Display back down to $25.99 shipped. Regularly $40, today’s deal takes $16 off and matches the all-time low we saw during the recent Prime Day sale. That’s 35% off, beating the offer we’re tracking directly at Anker. This is one of Anker’s newer compact chargers, and all available finishes are currently sitting at the same $25.99 low. Its built-in Smart Display can recognize supported iPhone models, optimize charging for safer power delivery, and show useful charging details alongside a few quirky animations. You also get up to 45W output through its single USB-C port, while the foldable prongs keep the whole thing compact enough for travel, a tech bag, or everyday carry.
